fields.label: Refill Reminder Enabled
fields.description: Enable this ONLY after full end-to-end testing is complete. Master on/off switch — scheduler checks this first.

fields.label: Remind N Days Before Refill Date
fields.description: Send the WhatsApp reminder this many days before next_refill_date. Default: 2 days.

fields.label: Template Name
fields.description: Exact template name from Meta Business Manager (case-sensitive). E.g. refill_reminder_patient

fields.label: Template Language Code
fields.description: Language code as approved in Meta Business Manager. Usually en_US or en.

fields.label: Webhook Verify Token
fields.description: Any secret string you choose. Must match exactly what you set in Meta Business Manager → Webhooks.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.options:
Webhook URL to register in Meta:
https://erp.taalhealthcare.com/api/method/taal_inventory.api.refill_webhook.handle

fields.label: API Credentials Note
fields.options: WhatsApp API credentials (phone_number_id, access_token) are shared with Doctor Consultation and are read from Doctor Consultation Meet Settings — no need to re-enter them here.
